integrity: All-parameter claims have written simplicial and module proofs plus a standalone finite reproducibility checker. Torsion concerns an Ext group, not ordinary homology. Self-review only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The graph-join wedge is nonequivariant; no general integral equivariant splitting criterion or full equivariant homotopy classification is asserted. The exact Ext order is specialized to cyclic rotations of complete graphs. Generic simplex skeletons and cyclic norm algebra are standard inputs, not claimed new. Literature equivalence risk persists.
title: Universal-apex higher independence complexes and unbounded equivariant splitting obstructions
